annotations.title: Verify up to 20 quotes on one web page in one call

description: Checks up to 20 quotes on one page: exact, fuzzy or none, offsets, signed receipt. US$0.02 per call; POST url, quotes. 10 free calls a day per IP, resetting at midnight UTC. Costs US$0.02 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it uses the free trial (10 calls a day per address), then returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/verify-quotes

quotes: These domains may be used as illustrative examples in documents

case_sensitive.description: Default false; must be false with match "passages".

match.description: For every quote: exact; fuzzy (default), which also accepts small differences; or passages, for a paraphrased claim: the 3 passages that share most of its words, scored, as evidence for you to judge (not a verdict).

quotes.description: 1 to 20 quotes to look for on that page, or with match "passages" claims to find support for (each max 1,000 characters after normalisation). One price for the call however many.

url.description: http(s) URL of the page to check (max 2,048 characters). Fetched once for all the quotes.

name: attestpage_verify_quotes

page.description: Page verdict and evidence, including server_ip, tls and headers (the network evidence also signed into the receipt).

results.description: One entry per quote, in request order, each the verify/quote result: match, score, start, end, context, occurrences, normalised_sha256; with match "passages" also passages [{ start, end, score, text, missing, flags }], scorer and note; on a PDF the match and each passage also give pdf_page and pdf_page_end (1-based). A quote too costly to match fuzzily has error (match_too_costly) and nulls instead, for that quote alone.

summary.description: Counts of exact, fuzzy, none (and passages) verdicts and failed quotes.

title: Verify up to 20 quotes on one web page in one call
